derived_from: the fields the implemented producer actually consumes and varies over, observed in the RB-15 V2 canary

invalid_record_handling.no_eligible_candidate: the frozen selector raises; the frozen budget contract already declares residual_expert_invalid = 'preserve_base_and_failure_metadata_no_target_row_keep_invalid_denominator_no_replacement'
invalid_record_handling.observed_cause: the local safety projection reported infeasible_conservative_fallback for every candidate, including the zero residual, so no candidate is eligible

required_fields.producer_evidence: one binding per (layout, team size, split)
the snapshot hash varies with the control step; the canary evaluates two decision steps per case and gets different snapshot hashes and rollout lengths
the RobotView hash, base action and selected candidate differ per robot at the same decision state
nine independent counterfactual continuations per (decision state, robot), each with its own canonical hash and cost
required_fields.role: which of the nine residual candidates

required_fields.producer_evidence: replica_count_for_family is 3 for F8/F9 and 1 otherwise; the canary covers both
required_fields.role: matched replica where the family declares one

required_fields.producer_evidence: recorded per evaluation and verified identical across all nine candidates of one decision state
the candidate set, insertion boundary, intervention duration and all four utility formulas come from this artifact; a different hash is a different label

supersedes_for_residual_jobs_only.why_insufficient: the stored identity stops at the cell, so the nine candidate continuations behind one dense row share one identity; they cannot be retried, deduplicated or audited individually under duplicate_semantic_identity_policy = 'reject'

uniqueness_rule: a counterfactual evaluation is uniquely identified by (residual_cell_job_id, decision_state_id, robot_id, candidate_index, replica_index); matched_stream_identity and residual_expert_spec_v2_sha256 are verification fields, not disambiguators
